solution:
**Calculation:**

Offshore production in 2011 -12 = 38.47

Offshore production in 2012 - 13 = 31.80

Difference = 38.47 - 31.80 = 6.67

Offshore production in 2013 - 14 = 26.39

Difference = 31.80 - 26.39 = 5.41

After the year 2013 - 14 production fall the years is minimal so we do not need to calculate the difference between them

**∴ Required answer is 2012-13**
